description: Check whether a token contract is safe to trade BEFORE swapping into it. Detects honeypots (buyable but not sellable), buy/sell taxes, mintable supply, pausable transfers, blacklists, hidden owners, reclaimable ownership, self-destruct, unverified source code, upgradeable proxies and holder concentration. Returns a 0-100 risk score with high/medium/low band, critical risks separated from warnings. Supports Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche. Use as a pre-trade gate or rug screen. Informational security data, not financial advice. Paid: $0.02 via x402.

chain.description: Chain: ethereum, base, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche (default ethereum)
